name: Henrietta le Noble
original_name: ヘンリエッタ＝ル・ノーブル
source:
Dressed in luxurious clothes, with a maid of honor at her side, she is a super rich princess living in a luxurious palace. She is also selfish and high spirited. 

She hates when things don't go her way, and is a constant source of annoyance to her entourage. She also believes that she is the most beautiful woman in the world and that no man can resist her charms. 

She happens to meet Kristof at a party and falls in love with him at first sight. Angry that he is not taken in by her good looks, she takes matters into her own hands and takes Kristof captive.

[From [url=https://frill.product.co.jp/frill03/chara.html]official site[/url]]
